summary: Iteration 16 (Stripe payments, Flow A sandbox) — full backend + frontend end-to-end verified. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass. POST /api/payments/checkout returns 200 with checkout_url starting https://checkout.stripe.com and session_id starting cs_test_; payment_transactions row created (status=initiated, payment_status=pending, amount=145.0, currency=eur). GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns session_id/status/payment_status/kind/amount. Unknown session → 404. kind='booking' on already-confirmed booking → 400. Invalid kind → 400. Booking with amount=0 (voucher-paid) → 400 'Aucun paiement requis'. Voucher checkout happy path → 200 with kind=voucher, pending; already-paid voucher → 400. Webhook POST /api/stripe/webhook without valid signature → 400. Frontend: /paiement?cancelled=1 → data-state='cancelled' with amber XCircle + payment-back link. /paiement?session_id=cs_test_unknown → data-state 'checking' then 'failed' after 3 polls (~6s). Full E2E: opened booking modal from landing, filled valid data (delivered@resend.dev, discovery, 2026-10-12, terms), submit → toast 'Redirection vers le paiement sécurisé…' → navigation to https://checkout.stripe.com/…, selected Card, filled 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12/34 / 123, name 'Test User', country Spain, address Calle Test 1, city Madrid, postal 28001, province VI, clicked Pay → redirected to {origin}/paiement?session_id=cs_test_a1Git…, PaymentPage transitioned to data-state='success' with 'Paiement reçu — votre vol est confirmé !' immediately after 1st poll. Verified via admin API: booking status=confirmed, paid_at + confirmed_at set (2026-09-04T17:20:57), confirmation_email_sent=true; backend log confirms 'Client confirmed-email sent (id=…) to delivered@resend.dev'. Payment fulfilment path is the polling endpoint fallback (as documented — Stripe webhook does not reach preview). All 7 test bookings + 2 test vouchers cancelled at end (no CA pollution).

minor.issue: payment_session_id is not exposed in the Booking model response (comes back as null even when set in DB). Does not affect the 'Payé en ligne' badge (uses paid_at). Consider adding payment_session_id: Optional[str] to Booking pydantic model if needed for admin diagnostics.

critical_code_review_comments: payments.py L66-68: automatic_tax fallback via except stripe.error.StripeError is correct; verified in preview (session created with automatic_tax enabled for CH-based sandbox — Spain billing works).
payments.py L21-30: _mark_paid uses find_one_and_update with payment_status $ne 'paid' — idempotent, safe against webhook + polling race.
server.py L769-772: fulfill_payment writes payment_session_id on the booking doc but Booking model does not declare that field, so it is silently stripped from GET responses (minor).
GiftModal.jsx L37-40: `return; onClose(); setForm(EMPTY);` — unreachable cleanup code after the return statement. Harmless because window.location.href navigates away, but should be cleaned up.
PaymentPage.jsx polling: attempts >=3 on network error → failed; attempts >=10 → pending (~20s). Correct per spec.
BookingsTable.jsx L68-69: 'Payé en ligne' emerald pill uses data-testid=`booking-paid-${b.id}` and gates on b.paid_at — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (cancelled state, unknown-session polling failure, booking→Stripe→success E2E with real 4242 card + Spain address, admin fulfilment verified via API)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Checkout UI on preview requires: (1) click 'Card' text to expand accordion, (2) fill #cardNumber #cardExpiry #cardCvc #billingName, (3) select #billingCountry to 'ES', (4) click 'Enter address manually' link, (5) fill #billingAddressLine1 #billingLocality #billingPostalCode, (6) select first option in #billingAdministrativeArea (province is required for Spain), (7) click button[data-testid='hosted-payment-submit-button']. Set viewport height >=1400 so the Pay button is reachable. Full flow: 30-90s. Webhook signature secret differs between Stripe dashboard and .env — webhook events do NOT reach the preview backend; fulfilment happens via GET /api/payments/status/{sid} polling which retrieves the session and calls _mark_paid on payment_status='paid'. That is the intended verification path.
rca of the issue: N/A — Stripe integration works end-to-end; only cosmetic finding is that payment_session_id is stripped by the Booking Pydantic model (not declared as a field). Suggest declaring `payment_session_id: Optional[str] = None` on Booking if the admin needs to display the Stripe session reference. Not blocking.
